getting-started-talking-to-sanfew.speaker: Sanfew
getting-started-talking-to-sanfew.text: What can I do for you young 'un?

options.text: Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?

steps.player: Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the requirements to start Eadgar's Ruse.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Not just yet, young 'un.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Eadgar's Ruse quest.
If the player has the requirements for Eadgar's Ruse except Herblore level:

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: 'm afraid you are not yet learned enough in the art of Herblore to be able to help me, adventurer...
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Eadgar's Ruse quest.
If the player has the requirements to start Eadgar's Ruse.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Ah, you've come just in time. I need a certain herb for the next part of the purification ritual...

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: It used to be quite common, but nowadays only the trolls know where to find it. They use it in their cooking, you see. It's a very prized ingredient.

steps.player: And what exactly do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Journey to the north into the land of the trolls, and find the secret of the herb the trolls call 'goutweed'.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: My friend Eadgar lives in the area, and he may be able to help you. Bring some goutweed back and I will teach you something useful.
If the player boosted Herblore to start the quest.
Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.

steps.player: I'll do it.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Thank you, adventurer!

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Oh well. No doubt some other adventurer will eventually come who can help me.

options.text: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.

steps.player: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, we all make mistakes sometimes.

steps.text: I've told you already.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Journey to the north into the land of the trolls, and find the secret of the herb the trolls call goutweed.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: My friend Eadgar lives in the area, and he may be able to help you. Bring some goutweed back and I will teach you something useful.

steps.player: I'll get on with it.

options.text: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.

getting-started-searching-the-laundry-ba.text: You search the laundry basket... It's full of dirty robes.

getting-started-talking-to-tegid.speaker: Tegid

getting-started-searching-the-rack.text: You look under the rack but find nothing.

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-before-t.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-before-t.text: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! Happiness in a bowl!

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-before-t.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-before-t.text: Would you care to sample our delicious home cooking?

options.text: I need to find some goutweed.

steps.player: I need to find some goutweed. Sanfew said you might be able to help.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Sanfew, you say? Ah, haven't seen him in a while...

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Goutweed is used as an ingredient in troll cooking. You should ask one of their cooks.

options.text: Why do you live so close to the trolls?
What do you have to offer?
Why do you live so close to the trolls?

steps.player: Why do you live so close to the trolls? Isn't it dangerous?

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Well, I suppose I do keep getting captured by the trolls and thrown in prison...But they always release me in the end, I'm far too old and skinny for their tastes.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: In any case, this is my home, and I'm not leaving it. And this area has the tastiest goats!

options.text: What do you have to offer?

steps.player: What do you have to offer?

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: The chef's recommendation for today is mountain goat stew. I'll give some stew in exchange for logs for my fire. They're hard to come by around here.

options.text: I'd like some mountain goat stew, please.

steps.player: I'd like some mountain goat stew, please.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Here you go! Enjoy!

steps.player: No thanks, Eadgar.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Your loss!

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Hmm? What human do in troll kitchen? Burntmeat tired of cooking goats. Human look tasty.

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.player: Oh, you don't want to eat me! I'm a tough, hardened adventurer, not tender or tasty at all!

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Hmm. Burntmeat think you probably right. What human doing here?

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.player: I'm on a quest to find some goutweed.

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Bwahahaha! Burntmeat not give his greatest cooking secret away so easily.

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.text: But Burntmeat also has quest for human!

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.speaker: Burntmeat
finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.text: Bring back a tasty human for Burntmeat's stew. If you find tasty human, Burntmeat will give you good reward.

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat.player: Right. I'll just...go fetch that for you then. Bye!

finding-eadgar-talking-to-burntmeat-agai.player: Erm, not yet, but I'm working on it...

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.text: If the player talked to Eadgar before talking to Burntmeat.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Oh, it's you. Have you talked to the troll cook yet?

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.text: If the player did not talk to Eadgar before talking to Burntmeat.

steps.player: I need to find some goutweed. Sanfew said you might be able to help.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Sanfew, you say? Ah, haven't seen him in a while...

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.player: I talked to the troll cook but he wouldn't tell me anything, and now he wants me to find him some tasty human for his stew.

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.text: Oh dear, that's no good. You can't just go hand over a human to those trolls...

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.text: Yes! It's bound to work. First of all, I will need a parrot!

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.player: A PARROT? Where am I going to find one of those?

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-after-ta.text: Anything else I can do for you?

options.text: Why do you live so close to the trolls?
What do you have to offer?

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-again-be.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-again-be.text: Oh, it's you. Have you got me a parrot yet?

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-again-be.player: I haven't been able to find one yet.

finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-again-be.speaker: Eadgar
finding-eadgar-taking-to-eadgar-again-be.text: Well, go see if the zoo have one.

steps.player: Where's the zoo?

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: It's in Ardougne, south west of here.

steps.player: Okay, I'll be right back.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Anything else I can do for you?

steps.player: Okay, I'll be right back.

steps.speaker: Eadgar
steps.text: Anything else I can do for you?

visiting-ardougne-using-pineapple-chunks.text: Why would you want to do that?

visiting-ardougne-talking-to-parroty-pet.speaker: Parroty Pete
visiting-ardougne-talking-to-parroty-pet.text: Good day, good day. Come to admire the new parrot aviary have we?

steps.player: It's very nice.

steps.speaker: Parroty Pete
steps.text: Isn't it just?

steps.player: When did you add it?

steps.speaker: Parroty Pete
steps.text: Just recently. It would have been sooner, but some wretch thought it would be amusing to replace their drinking water with vodka. The vet had to nurse them back to health for weeks!

steps.player: What do you feed them?

steps.speaker: Parroty Pete
steps.text: Well, fruit and grain mostly. I try to give them a balanced diet, but their favourite treat is pineapple chunks.

visiting-ardougne-using-vodka-on-the-avi.player: They won't drink it straight from the bottle...

visiting-ardougne-using-pineapple-chunks.text: You manage to attract a parrot, but it flies away when you try to catch it.

visiting-ardougne-using-pineapple-chunks.player: I need some way to slow it down...

visiting-ardougne-using-alco-chunks-on-t.text: If the player has not spoken to Eadgar with the drunk parrot in their inventory:

steps.text: You manage to attract a parrot and catch it.

steps.player: Hah! Got you now!

steps.speaker: Parrot
steps.text: Sqwaawk...*hic*

steps.speaker: Parroty Pete
steps.text: Hey! What are you doing with that parrot?

steps.player: Nothing.

steps.speaker: Parroty Pete
steps.text: It looks drunk! You should NEVER feed alcohol to a parrot!

steps.player: Well, good thing I found it! I'll just take it to the vet for you, shall I?

steps.speaker: Parroty Pete
steps.text: Oh, thank you! We're ever so busy here at the Zoo.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: Oh, it's you. Have you got me a parrot yet?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.player: Here it is! Now are you going to explain your plan?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: Yes, yes, of course. It's quite ingenious really!

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: What we need is something that looks like a human, sounds like a human, smells like a human and tastes like a human.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.player: How are we going to make it look like a human?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: We'll just make a scarecrow. We'll need logs, and 10 sheaves of wheat for stuffing.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.player: How are we going to make it sound like a human?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: That's what the parrot's for, of course.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: Although the trolls might get suspicious if it doesn't say what they expect a human to say...

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: You should hide it for a while somewhere it can pick up some more appropriate catchphrases.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.player: How are we going to make it smell like a human?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: Well, we'll need to dress it up anyway; if we use dirty clothes it'll smell human to the trolls.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: I'm a man of few clothes myself, so you might want to ask old Sanfew about that one.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.player: And how are we going to make it taste like a human?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: That's easy, we'll just stuff it with a few chickens. Everything tastes like chicken! Five raw chickens should be enough.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: That's the plan. Anything else I can do for you?

options.text: Why do you live so close to the trolls?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.player: What should I do with this parrot?

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: I told you, put it somewhere it'll learn to say the sort of thing the trolls will expect it to say.

preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.speaker: Eadgar
preparing-the-fake-man-talking-to-eadgar.text: This is likely to be screaming. There's bound to be a good spot somewhere in the troll prison.

obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-sanfew-ab.speaker: Sanfew
obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-sanfew-ab.text: What can I do for you young 'un?

steps.player: Eadgar says he needs some dirty clothes for his plan, and he said you might be able to help.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Now why would he need that?

steps.player: It's a long story.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Never mind then... I think Tegid is doing his laundry outside. You could ask him if you can borrow one of his dirty robes.

obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-tegid-abo.speaker: Tegid
obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-tegid-abo.text: Yes. What is it to you?

obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-tegid-abo.player: You wouldn't be able to spare any of those dirty robes by any chance? It's a matter of the utmost importance.

obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-tegid-abo.speaker: Tegid
obtaining-the-robes-talking-to-tegid-abo.text: What? No! These are my robes!

steps.player: Fine.
I'm sure Sanfew won't be happy when I tell him it's your fault he can't perform the purification ritual.

steps.speaker: Tegid
steps.text: What? Oh well, if it's a matter of that much importance, I suppose you can borrow one...

options.text: You'll give me those robes right now...

steps.player: You'll give me those robes right now...or I'm going to cut down trees until you do.

steps.speaker: Tegid
steps.text: You wouldn't dare!

steps.player: Of course I would. They're just trees.

steps.speaker: Tegid
steps.text: You monster! Take the robes and leave this place!

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: That's everything!

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: Good, good, everything is almost finished.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: Of course, we can't just give him the dummy and expect to get anything useful out of him.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: No, of course not. We need to make sure he'll tell you what you need to know.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.player: And how do we do that?

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: I happen to know that the trolls are susceptible to a certain kind of plant that grows around this mountain. I call it Troll Thistle. If properly prepared, it can be made into a sort of Troll truth potion.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: You'll have to dry it in a fire, then grind it and mix it into a potion with Ranarr weed.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.player: Okay, I'll be back with that soon.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.speaker: Eadgar
returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: Anything else I can do for you?

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-using-.player: I'd better not mess around with Eadgar's stew!

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.player: I've got the troll truth potion.

returning-to-eadgar-with-supplies-talkin.text: Excellent, thank you. Now just go fetch that poor parrot back, it's probably had enough by now.
